symptom: `mxcli git merge side -p App.mpr` on a working tree with an uncommitted change the merge would overwrite fails with `git merge side: Updating 5d6b73c..2c3fd47`, and without a git identity with `git merge side: ` and nothing after it; the same with `--plan`
cause: When git merge stopped before any conflict existed (no MERGE_HEAD), the error was built from `firstLineOf(mergeOut)` — git's stdout, which holds at most the fast-forward 'Updating a..b' line — while git's reason is on stderr, which gitOutIn already returns as the error
insight: **A wrapper that splits stdout from stderr has to pick the stream per outcome**: git writes progress to stdout and refusals to stderr, so the line that is right on success is the wrong one on failure. Found only because a fixture ran on a host where git could not guess an identity — the empty message was the first clue. Pattern: docs-wiki/bug-patterns/misleading-diagnostics.md
